CustomField.formula: MAX( 0, IF( Minimum_Engagement_Applied__c, Shift_Calculated_Duration__c, ( MOD(Shift_Duration_Days__c * 1440, 1440) / 60 ) - IF( NOT(Staff_Paid_Break__c), Shift_Break__c, 0 ) - Extended_Duration__c ) + SCHADS_Minimum_Hours__c - Removed_Duration__c )
CustomField.label: Shift Duration
